z_composite_construction.missing_z_handling: Outer join. Ticker present only in one alpha → that alpha's z is actual, missing one set to 0 (no penalty / no bonus).

sr_realized_share_based.description: Primary measurement basis. Net returns post-15bps cost, 4-sleeve Return.portfolio rebalanced monthly.

harvey_capm_alpha_nw_lag6.method: lm(net_return ~ KOSPI200_BM_Ret) + Newey-West HAC variance (lag 6) via sandwich::NeweyWest + lmtest::coeftest

dsr_bailey_ldp_m10.method: Bailey-Lopez de Prado 2014 closed-form. E[max SR_M] = ((1-gamma)*Phi^-1(1-1/M) + gamma*Phi^-1(1-1/(M*e))) / sqrt(N). DSR = Phi((SR_obs - E[max SR_M]) / sigma_SR).
dsr_bailey_ldp_m10.interpretation: All 3 variants strict PASS DSR > 0.95. SR ~1.0 strongly exceeds expected max-of-10 trials (0.32 annualized) — multi-test correction comfortable.

diebold_mariano_pairwise_nw_lag6.method: DM stat = mean(r_1 - r_2) / SE_NW(d). NW HAC variance with lag 6.
diebold_mariano_pairwise_nw_lag6.verdict: Statistically no clear winner among 3 weighting variants. MDD axis separability (C_softmax -22.94% vs A_EW -27.56%) is meaningful for production constraint adherence.
